test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Desert.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abandon"** means to give up completely or to leave someone or something behind, often with no intention of returning. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example: **He decided to abandon his old car because it was no longer worth repairing.
 
 
 
• **"Desert" **refers to leaving a place, person, or thing that you are responsible for, with no intention of returning. (छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers were accused of deserting their posts during the battle.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- Desert.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reclaim **(पुनः प्राप्त करना): To retrieve or recover something previously lost.
 
 
• **Example:** She went to reclaim her lost luggage at the airport.
 
 
 
• **Possess **(अधिकार में रखना ): To have or own something.
 
 
• **Example: **He possesses a rare collection of vintage stamps.
 
 
 
• **Commence** (प्रारंभ करना): To begin or start something.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting will commence at 10 AM sharp.
 
 

140:Tc5f,
The correct answer is **Option 2**
